nodes.label: 8. Disease Prediction
nodes.rationale: Outputs a predicted condition (example: Pneumonia 84%) together with top contributing concepts and their classifier-weight contributions (Opacity +0.32, Consolidation +0.28, Atelectasis +0.12, Edema +0.09).

nodes.label: 12. Explainability Evaluation
